commandPalette.title: Command menu
commandPalette.description: Search for a page or action and press Enter to run it.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work everywhere except in text fields.

inbox.emptyDescription: Messages appear here once a mail account is connected.

tasks.emptyDescription: Tasks found in your messages are listed here.

digest.emptyDescription: A daily summary of new messages is created after the first sync.

search.emptyDescription: Search covers all synced messages and attachments.

settings.more: Mail accounts, language models and notifications will be configured here.
settings.serverDescription: Status of the connection to the ollamail server.

admin.auditDescription: Sign-ins, role changes, key rotation and other security events.
admin.more: Mail providers and language models will be managed here once these areas are available.
admin.signInDescription: Identity providers, LDAP directories and local accounts.
admin.roleMappingDescription: Derive roles from the groups of your identity provider.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.emptyDescription: Security events such as sign-ins and role changes are recorded here.

signIn.title: Sign-in
signIn.localDescription: E-mail address and password stored in ollamail.
signIn.emergency: Emergency access if every sign-in fails: python -m app.cli reset-password in the api container.
signIn.emptyProviders: No identity provider yet. Add Microsoft Entra ID, Google, OpenID Connect or LDAP so people can sign in with their existing account.

disableLocal.title: Disable local sign-in?
disableLocal.description: Afterwards people can only sign in through an identity provider. Local passwords stay stored and work again once local sign-in is enabled.
disableLocal.selfWarning: You currently sign in with a local account only. Make sure you can sign in through an identity provider before you continue, otherwise you lock yourself out.
disableLocal.lockout: Not possible: no administrator could sign in afterwards. First give an administrator access through an active identity provider.

signIn.lockout: Not possible: no administrator could sign in afterwards.

provider.redirectUriHint: Register this address as redirect URI (web platform) at the identity provider.
provider.readOnly: Configured in the environment (OLLAMAIL_AUTH_OIDC_PROVIDERS); change it there.
provider.testOkOidc: Discovery document and {{count}} signing keys loaded.
provider.testSecretHint: The client secret is checked at the first real sign-in.
provider.lookupNotFound: No such user in the directory.
provider.lookupNotAllowed: Not allowed to sign in (allowed groups).
provider.removeHint: Users stay; they can no longer sign in through this provider.
provider.githubCheck: GitHub has no connection test: client ID, secret and organisation membership are checked at the first sign-in.

wizard.title: Add provider
wizard.chooseType: Which service do your people sign in with?

presets.ldapDescription: Sign-in with directory user name and password

fields.name: Key
fields.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; part of the redirect URI. Cannot be changed later.
fields.tenantHint: Overview page of the app registration in Entra ID.
fields.hostedDomainHint: Only accounts of this domain can sign in.
fields.clientSecretHint: Stored encrypted. Leave empty for public clients (PKCE only).
fields.organizationsHint: Organisation names, separated by commas. Empty: every GitHub account can sign in.

wizard.verifyOidc: Register the redirect URI at the identity provider, then test the connection.
wizard.verifyLdap: Test the connection and, optionally, look up a user before enabling the directory.
wizard.savedDisabled: Saved, not enabled yet: nobody can sign in with it until you enable it.
wizard.verifyGithub: Register the callback URL in the OAuth app at GitHub, then enable the provider.

roleMapping.title: Role mapping
roleMapping.enabledDescription: At every sign-in through an identity provider the role is determined from the groups. Roles set by hand are overwritten for these users.
roleMapping.rulesHint: Group as the provider reports it: Entra ID object ID, LDAP group DN, OIDC group name. Case does not matter.
roleMapping.noRules: No rules yet. Everyone gets the default role.
roleMapping.lastAdminHint: The last active administrator is never demoted at sign-in.
roleMapping.duplicate: Each group can only have one rule per provider.
roleMapping.testDescription: Which role would a sign-in with these groups get (saved rules)?
roleMapping.testOff: Role mapping is off; roles stay as they are.

users.title: Users
users.noMailAccess: Administrators manage accounts but never see other people's mail.
users.lockout: Not possible: no administrator could sign in afterwards. First make another user an administrator.
users.roleManaged: Role mapping is on: roles of users who sign in through an identity provider are set at their next sign-in.

self.warning: You lose access to the admin area immediately and cannot undo this yourself.

inviteSheet.title: Invite user
inviteSheet.description: Creates a local account. Pass the link on; the person sets their own password.
inviteSheet.linkDescription: Valid until {{date}}. It is shown only once; you can create a new one at any time.
inviteSheet.localDisabled: Local sign-in is disabled; invited users could not sign in.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address does not exist or is no longer available.

errors.badRequest: The request could not be processed.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.
errors.conflict: The item was changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.server: A server error occurred. Please try again later.

auth.passwordTooShort_other: The password must have at least {{count}} characters.

login.invalidCredentials: E-mail address or password is incorrect.
login.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.noMethods: No sign-in method is configured. Contact your administrator.

setup.title: Set up ollamail
setup.description: Create the first account. It gets administrator rights and can add further users and sign-in methods.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, unless the server requires a different length.
setup.tokenHint: Shown in the server log at start-up (setup_code) or set via OLLAMAIL_SETUP_TOKEN.
setup.alreadyInitialized: This instance has already been set up. Sign in instead.
setup.providersDescription: Connect Microsoft Entra ID, Google, GitHub or LDAP so that others can sign in with their existing account. You can do this later in the admin area.

invite.title: Set your password
invite.description: You were invited to ollamail as {{email}}.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.

account.title: Account
account.timeZoneDescription: Used for dates, digests and reminders.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: This page is only available to administrators.
